checks.name: The bad run selects the actual released instance and its audit
The guarded run has an active reference but explicitly no released model
Catalog keeps seven distinct runtime identities including four trained candidates and a failed attempt
Reference history separates three committed changes from the discarded write in source order
Every model selection changes inspection without changing the recorded release outcome
Validation coverage follows content digest, while matching runtime identity remains separate
Failed retry shows discard and explicit Python cleanup; successful retry shows a commit
Legacy and guarded release evidence preserves actual conditions and observed read keys
Every source entry resolves to the original raw record
A model selection from another run cannot join reused numeric handles
Missing observer/backend evidence remains unknown rather than inventing failed-attempt facts
Renaming model labels does not change identity-based conclusions
A later commit of the same reference cannot retroactively commit an earlier failed attempt
Projection needs no runtime tree, precomputed diagnosis, or custom question answers

browserQA: Separate interactive checks cover selection, evidence dialog, guarded run, responsive layout and offline export.
